programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Animals, Jack Jones, The Volantes, Peter O'Toole, John Byner, and Joan Sutherland.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Guest star Lucille Ball joins Carol for a glittering showbiz sketch, 'The Rock Sisters!'
Steven Wright brings his signature monotone to the show and Rose Gries discusses being the oldest Avon Lady. Plus Johnny jokes about air quality and notes the human brain has gotten smaller.
Tim Conway returns to the Carol show! Tim plays a lion who wants to be anything but Born Free, then teams with Harvey as a pair of military aircraft spotters stuck with each other on an island.
Tonight's guest star is the fabulous Cher! Sketches include Harvey and Tom as dueling pianists, spoofs of commercials, and a love triangle between Harvey, Cher...and Carol as the mousy "other woman."
Tim Conway and Pat Carroll guest star in this episode. Tim contributes in sketches as the Lone Ranger and as a man who lives a dog's life, and Pat joins in on the latest "Carol & Sis" installment.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Guest stars Ken Berry and Totie Fields drop by to take part in some of Carol's most popular recurring sketches: Carol & Sis and As The Stomach Turns.
Kaye Ballard and Tim Conway are Carol's guests tonight for an evening of sketches, highlighted by the game show spoof "The Dater's Game", and Tim as a service station attendant meeting a bank robber.
Two-time Oscar winner Elizabeth Taylor chats about her new perfume, addiction programs, her seven husbands, and her most marriage to construction worker Larry Fortensky.
Garry Shandling was a regular guest and always had something new and fun to discuss. This time, the topics are laundromats and Disneyland!
Famed Shakespearean actor Kenneth Branagh was young when he visited Johnny and talks about the thrill of meeting Kirk Douglas
Ed Sullivan presents performances by The Band, The Byrds, Creedence Clearwater Revival, The Lovin' Spoonful, Richie Havens, and Smokey Robinson.
Carol's guests tonight are Rock Hudson and Nancy Walker! The two join Carol and company for sketch set in the grand old days of vaudeville, entitled: "When My Baby Laughs At Me."

programmes.t: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
programmes.d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests Jimmy Stewart and Dom DeLuise.
Fellow talk show host Dick Cavett talks about his early days in the business and what it was like to write jokes for Johnny.
Guest stars Ken Berry and Totie Fields drop by to take part in some of Carol's most popular recurring sketches: "Carol & Sis" and "As The Stomach Turns."

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Carl Reiner and Melba Moore guest star on this episode, highlighted by the Non-Violent Theatre presentation of a WWII film- 'The Plot To Hurt Hitler.'

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Gerry and the Pacemakers, Dusty Springfield, Doug Hart, Phyllis Diller, Itzhak Perlman, and the Wieniawski's.
Tonight's episode features another round of commercial spoofs, Harvey attempting to give a speech in spite of Tim's noisy distractions, and Carol demonstrating to Vicki how nobody notices her.
Tonight: Cass Elliot and Ricardo Montalban! Mama Cass teams with Carol for a sketch about wallflowers at a dance, while Ricardo takes on the role of a playboy in a spoof of Esther Williams movies.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Fabian, Carol Lawrence and Ed Wynn, Baron Buika, Conrad Buckner, Billy Storm, and The Goofers.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Smokey Robinson & The Miracles, Santana, The Muppets (interview sketch with Rex Robbins), Albert Almoznino, Dickie Henderson, and Trio Hoganas.

Guest star Martha Raye is back, appearing in "Carol & Sis" as an Irish maid who doesn't live up to her advertising. And George (Harvey) fantasizes about being a matador--but can't escape Zelda (Carol).

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Lovin' Spoonful, Johnny Rivers and Dancers, George Carlin, Cab and Chris Calloway, Trio Hoganas, and Ross and Hunt.
Bernadette Peters and Donald O'Connor take the stage for a night filled with laughter and music, highlighted by Carol and Bernadette's duet in a bridal shop. Also: "Carol & Sis" and "The Old Folks."
Prop comic Gallagher joins Johnny. Chevy Chase also gets major laughs for his imitation of Gerald Ford.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Guest star Steve Lawrence takes the stage to sing a duet with Dick, while Tim cracks jokes and a case as drunken private eye Danny Draft.
Ed Sullivan presents performances by Elvis Presley, Bobby Rydell, Dino, Desi & Billy, Tom Jones, Paul Anka, and Bobby Darin.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Tim plays a 35 year old orphan looking to be adopted in a sketch, then joins Jack and Carol for tonight's Old Old Movie, 'The Story Of A Star.'
TV star and stand-up comic Paul Reiser tells Johnny what he says to people, so they’ll think he’s listening to them when he really isn’t.
Famed comedian Richard Pryor pokes fun at his failure at marriage and reflects on his new sobriety. Fellow guest and The Breakfast Club star Ally Sheedy describes life as a senior at USC.

Would you believe Don Adams guest stars? Don plays a talk show host beset with technical difficulties, Carol's agitated husband in "The Lost Purse," and (with Harvey) one of a pair of griping fathers.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Supremes, The Alcettys, Frank Ifield, Roberta Peters, and Holiday on Ice.
John Lithgow and Buddy Hackett stop by the couch, plus Johnny talks about the Christmas season.
Andy Griffith and Barbara McNair join Carol and the gang tonight! Sketches include a football coach who can't help but bring his work home with him, and a production number about Smokey The Bear.
Guest star Michele Lee headlines a wintry and wonderful production number in this episode, which also offers another visit with the 10th Street Family.
Guest stars Michele Lee and Flip Wilson respectively dazzle with song and stand-up comedy, and Carol vamps in "V.I.P." as Hollywood sex symbol Mae East.
